verdict.label: duplicate
verdict.why: Partial overlap only. Both functions independently derive the same local-restart status from an UpdateEverythingRun and UpdateRunLocalState. The shared steps are: (1) the countdown check `phase === "countdown" && restartAt !== null` with seconds computed as `Math.max(0, Math.ceil((restartAt - now) / 1000))`; (2) the `installing` phase meaning a restart is in progress; (3) the downloading label with an optional `Math.floor(percent)%` suffix when percent is non-null. A small helper in updateEverything.logic.ts, such as `restartCountdownSeconds(run, now)` and `downloadingSuffix(local)`, or a function returning a structured local status, would own this policy. Callers would keep their own wording and casing ("restarts in Ns" vs "Restart in Ns"), tone and action fields, and the machine-based slow/failed/progress logic that only describeUpdateCapsule has. The overlap is small and the two outputs are formatted differently, so confidence is moderate.
